title: Confluence guide retrieval/authoring — end-to-end QA / dry run
description: Detailed, phased manual QA plan validating the full guide-authoring (documentation-mcp) to guide-retrieval (ai-intake-mcp) loop against a real Confluence Cloud space and real Jira ticket. Executed 2026-09-06/07 -- all phases passed (GO), finding and fixing 3 real bugs (bare-domain site URL, entity decoding in both repos, CDATA data loss) that 451 combined unit tests never caught.
